svg.aria-label: Block schematic of the diffusion source: the elaboration, the walk and its one generator, the canvas with three faces, the column engine with its memories bands array and epilogue, the draw, and the five broadcast families the round answered
svg.text: The diffusion machine — era six, rung 1 on the Nexys 4
One canvas of T steps by four seats. A rewind draws it whole through N passes of blocked Gibbs; a step plays one of its frames. docs/diffusion_rtl.md is the design.
L1 · Elaboration.t — a value, and THE ONLY MODULE THAT READS THE MODEL. A new checkpoint moves one line of gen_verilog and nothing else.
the layer table, 16 rows · the weight image in DWELL order · the norm words, gain and shift and bias at one address · the anneal table · the seat openings · the temper
Source — the era's face to Source_intf, unchanged. ONE unit: the FSM, the generator, the openings, the alpha ROM, the draw service and the socket.
one rest, thus rewind is read where idle stands and the generator's load rides it
OPEN and MASK are ONE cell walk with two write faces; the frame that WRITES
stands two cycles behind the frame that DRAWS, thus a phase costs two more
xorshift32, one step a cycle. It serves the
opening, every mask and every draw IN ONE
ORDER — the consumption order is the rule.
and a byte lands one cycle behind its step
N entries of 24 bits: the annealed schedule
of the paper, on the generator's own grid
read at the start of the pass through the
registered read — the address before the
memory, which is era four's rule
T × 4 cells, registers: a class and
a mask bit for each. Written IN
at the rung shape, in Cyclesim
pass 0 is the HOTTEST — alpha opens
Forward · the column engine — one pass over the canvas as it stands. It takes the elaboration itself, thus no width is stated twice.
the dwell is the column, then the output group, then the input channel, then the tap — nine cycles of work, and every fetch of the rotation hides under it
T · H columns of P × 16 bits;
gain, shift and bias at ONE
the dwell order, thus the address
rotated IN PLACE: t-1, t, t+1;
beyond the roll, a zero column
G entries a group; one band
G columns of X for the join
L2 · Column_array — P rows × G lanes = 192 DSP48, one for each lane
weight-stationary: ONE WEIGHT READ FEEDS P LANES. Two broadcast trees — the weight to every row, the column to every
lane — and the accumulation stands INSIDE the DSP over the 9·Cin dwell, thus no adder tree stands anywhere.
the array's output port: without it that port is P by G by 32 bits, which is neither wireable nor testable alone.
ONE capture register drives every stage of it.
the folded norm — gain, shift, bias — then the
ReLU, the clamp, and the residual add of a close
fed by the norm bank and the residual band above
the output band → the column write
G columns buffered, then one write a cycle when
the band stands whole. A pass leaves the stores
as it found them, except X — thus no clear.
the logit file · four columns of P × int16 — THE HEAD WRITES ONE STEP AND NOT A TENSOR
step_ready is a LEVEL and NO TAG CROSSES THE SEAM: the walk counts its own acknowledgements, and that count IS the step.
Draw · one cell's logits and one uniform into one class
era four's pipeline, and THE PICK ALWAYS LANDS — the peak's own weight is the whole of Q15, thus no last-class arm stands below.
the seat's logits, standing still exactly while the level stands
the drawn class → the cell port
Ring 3, the broadcast round and the ROM round — THE MACHINE MEETS on the real part, and every resource lands on the model.
one for each lane, exactly, and every
absorption of era four's trap still
holds — the B port alone now runs
under the cost model's ~100, once the weight
ROM banks and stops paying its full address
the broadcast round took it to +0.010 and
the banks to +0.007, each on one roll
the five families, and what answered each
① the draw's magnitude cone, cut in four
② the weight bytes: a mux, then a replica
③ the capture select, a bank a stage
④ band_row, a replica a slice
⑤ the window slots and the bands, sliced
NO ARRAY-SCALE NET KEEPS A SINGLE DRIVER, and that is the whole of the broadcast round. Ring 3 first read −6.125 on a family of five: one RAMB36 output bit drove 528 pins at
12.4 ns of PURE ROUTE, because the rule that buys the zero logic levels — the data register absorbed INTO the BRAM — leaves no flop in the fabric to replicate. The answer is a
dont_touch replica bank at every slice of eight rows, and the draw's 21-level magnitude cone cut into four registers. A ROM PAYS FOR ITS WHOLE ADDRESS SPACE and no warning says
so either: rung 2's image padded 36 144 words to 65 536 and lost EVERY ROM to fabric. Banked, rung 2 meets at +0.008 with 124.0 tiles (91.9%) and 21 419 LUTs against 42 599.
